title.en: Where does this permission come from?

hints.tr: Kullanıcının rolleri `user_roles.get(user, [])`; her rol için `permission in role_perms.get(role, [])`.
hints.en: The user's roles are `user_roles.get(user, [])`; for each role, `permission in role_perms.get(role, [])`.
A list comprehension and `sorted` are enough.
